title: How Safe Is ChatGPT Health Advice? Evidence from Real User Conversations in Four Global South Countries

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing context-blind and context-aware safety scores, high-risk rates, and health intents of ChatGPT's health advice between self-reported male and female users.
Comparing context-blind and context-aware safety scores, high-risk rates, and health intents of ChatGPT's health advice across different user age groups (18-25, 26-35, and 36+).

Evaluating and comparing the safety, failure modes, and health intent distributions of LLM health advice across users from four different Global South countries (India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Pakistan).
